messages.序盤は守備「守」を連打して呼吸を溜め、25を超えた呼吸威力を月下青刀に変えてから: A Poise Identity for longer battles. Repeatedly use defense's Defend [守] early to build Poise, convert Potency above 25 into Moonlit Azure Blade, then fight with critical Coin reuse from S2 Nameless Slash [無名斬] and S3 Fallstar Slayer [落星一殺].
messages.守備「守」と「回」: 「守」はマッチ可能ガードで、戦闘開始時に呼吸6/8と呼吸回: **Defense skills Defend [守] and Swerve [回]**: Defend is a Clashable Guard that grants 6/8 Poise and 1/2 Poise Count at Combat Start (once per turn). If Poise Potency is 25 or more at Turn Start, it turns into the Evade Swerve, which grants Shield equal to Moonlit Azure Blade and 4 Poise Count at Combat Start.
messages.「精神一到」: ターン終了時、25を超えた分の呼吸威力を最大15まで月下青刀に変: **Singular Focus of the Mind**: At Turn End, converts Poise Potency above 25 into Moonlit Azure Blade, up to 15. On turns he equips no attack skills (including E.G.O), he restores 5 SP at Combat Start and gains 1 Slash Power Up next turn, so spamming his Defense skill does not drop his SP.
messages.月下青刀: 最大20。ターン開始時に1につきバリア2、1につきクリティカルダメー: **Moonlit Azure Blade**: Maximum 20. At Turn Start, Shield of 2 per point, and +1% Critical damage per point.
messages.S2「無名斬」: 3枠の広域乱射。Ⅱコインはクリティカル表面的中時に再使用し、そ: **S2 — Nameless Slash [無名斬]**: A 3-target Unfocused Volley. Coin Ⅱ is reused on Critical Heads Hit, and if that reuse lands Heads with 10 or more Moonlit Azure Blade, it is reused once more (the second at Uptie Ⅳ; once per skill each). Base Power also rises with Poise, up to 2.
messages.S3「落星一殺」: 1コイン。呼吸と月下青刀に応じてコイン威力・基本威力が上がる: **S3 — Fallstar Slayer [落星一殺]**: 1 Coin. Coin Power and Base Power rise with Poise and Moonlit Azure Blade. Before attacking, +1 Attack Weight per 10 Moonlit Azure Blade (up to 2), and after attacking, spends 7/5 Moonlit Azure Blade per Attack Weight gained. If there are fewer targets than its Attack Weight, +30/50% damage per missing target. At 20 Moonlit Azure Blade, all Coins are Unbreakable.
messages.バトルパッシブ「整剣」(傲慢×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時に(傲慢共: **Combat passive — The Orthodox Blade [整劍] (2 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, gains (Pride Resonance ÷ 2) + 1 Poise, up to 4. At Combat End, +1 Poise Count if Poise is 20 or more.
messages.最初の2〜3ターンは攻撃スキルを装着せずに「守」を使い、呼吸を溜める。呼吸が20: For the first 2–3 turns, use Defend without equipping attack skills to build Poise. Switching to attacks once Poise is around 20 works well. Build 2 Pride Resonance every turn to activate The Orthodox Blade too. Bringing Moonlit Azure Blade to 10 or more unlocks S2's second reuse and S3's Attack Weight increase, which is where he hits his stride. When Poise Count is about to run out, top it up with Swerve. His slow start makes him weak in short fights, and he shines in drawn-out battles and boss fights with Unbreakable Coins.
